title: Skip consumed diagnostic blocks to prevent TAP-quoted text fabricating results
context: Parser re-visited diagnostic blocks after consuming them; quoted TAP syntax inside assertion diffs (legitimate in this repo's own test errors) was fabricating phantom passes/failures without actual re-runs, potentially marking bugs as fixed that were never retested. Touches invariant(s): con_2ce3f2a547 (Synthesis must use an explicitly selected coding-assistant subscription CLI or the deterministic local fallback; never call a pay-per-token API).
decision: Advance i past each consumed block (i = j - 1) so the loop never re-processes diagnostic content; quoted TAP lines remain diagnostic context, not parsed as real results.
consequences: Quoted TAP syntax in error messages no longer corrupts synthesis results
Previously-open bugs won't falsely appear fixed due to phantom passes
Loop control becomes explicit: j declared outside inner scope, i advanced post-block consumption
alternatives_rejected: Stricter TAP syntax validation to exclude quoted lines (fails on legitimate assertion diffs)
Escape or sanitize quoted TAP in errors (hides real TAP, doesn't fix parser)
Detect quoted context and skip parsing (increases parser complexity)
